result:
I've submitted the flux memo. Here's where things landed:

**Three lines breached both thresholds (>10% and >$5,000):**

| Account | Feb | Mar | Var $ | Var % |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5000 Hosting | 31,301.80 | 40,948.20 | +9,646.40 | +30.8% |
| 6300 Travel | 785.40 | 7,158.41 | +6,373.01 | +811% |
| 6400 Marketing | 7,898.14 | 29,686.00 | +21,787.86 | +276% |

**Hosting holds up cleanly.** It traces exactly to two supported AP entries: the recurring Stackline production invoice (JE-00232, $31,148.20) and a one-time data migration invoice (JE-00258, $9,800.00). The recurring run-rate actually *declined* $153.60 vs February, and -153.60 + 9,800.00 reconciles to the variance to the penny. This is non-recurring — April should revert to ~$31.1K.

**Two things you should know about the rest:**

First, I ran out of tool-call budget before pulling the Travel and Marketing detail. Rather than write a plausible-sounding narrative, I left both explicitly unexplained — that's $28,160.87 of the $33,712.40 total increase with no verified driver. My main concern on Marketing is that a +276% move of that size is a classic prepaid-campaign signature; if it's a Q2 program payment it belongs in 1200, not March expense. The AP cutoff review being open means the control that would catch a misdated invoice hasn't run yet either.

Second, and this affects how you read the whole schedule: the flux is distorted by unposted close entries. Depreciation shows -$3,425 (-100%) and Bank Fees -$65 (-100%) — those aren't cost savings, they're entries that haven't been made. Corrected for depreciation alone the total variance is nearer +14.2%. I'd also treat the +0.4% Salaries line as suspect until the March payroll accrual posts; at $184K it only takes a 2.7% swing to become a reportable line itself.

I didn't post any entries or mark the Flux review item complete, since nothing here reached a supportable conclusion. I also couldn't file formal exceptions for the Travel/Marketing items — the budget was gone — so those are documented in the memo instead and need to be raised if the detail review comes up empty.
